threads.body: Pinning `gh-aw` is good for reproducibility, but bumping the version can change validation/compiler behavior. To avoid unexpected CI drift, consider adding a short note in the script comment header indicating why `v0.84.3` is required (e.g., bugfix/feature) and, if applicable, the minimum compatible `gh` CLI version for this extension release.
threads.hunk:
@@ -16,7 +16,7 @@
 # (e.g. added or removed actions) that strict mode otherwise refuses. It does not affect which
 # actions the compiler generates, so the output still matches what the CI check produces.
 
-gh extension install github/gh-aw --pin v0.83.5
+gh extension install github/gh-aw --pin v0.84.3
